name: users
definition: 在问答社区中注册并拥有账户的自然人，具有声誉值、注册时间与访问记录等属性。 Counterexample: 与 badges 中的徽章授予记录不同：徽章记录是用户获得荣誉的事件性信息，而用户是荣誉的承受主体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table users; provenance: direct source users

name: badges
definition: 记录某用户在某时间获得某名称徽章的信息条目，包含徽章名称与授予日期。 Counterexample: 与用户不同：徽章授予记录是荣誉授予的信息记录，用户是荣誉的获得者。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table badges; provenance: direct source badges

name: comments
definition: 用户针对某帖子发表的文字反馈信息，包含评分、正文与创建时间。 Counterexample: 与帖子不同：评论依附于帖子存在，是短文本反馈；帖子是独立发布的问答内容主体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table comments; provenance: direct source comments

name: postHistory
definition: 记录帖子历次修订动作的信息条目，包含修订类型、修订标识、时间与操作者。 Counterexample: 与帖子不同：修订历史是帖子变更过程的记录，帖子是变更所作用的当前内容实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table postHistory; provenance: direct source postHistory

name: postLinks
definition: 记录两个帖子之间关联关系的信息条目，包含链接类型与创建时间。 Counterexample: 与帖子不同：帖子链接描述帖子之间的关联，帖子是关联两端的独立内容实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table postLinks; provenance: direct source postLinks

name: posts
definition: 用户在问答社区中发布的问答内容实体，具有标题、正文、标签、评分与浏览计数等属性。 Counterexample: 与评论不同：帖子是独立发布的内容主体，评论是依附于帖子的短文本反馈。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table posts; provenance: direct source posts

name: tags
definition: 用于对帖子主题进行分类的词汇条目，包含标签名称与使用计数。 Counterexample: 与帖子不同：标签是分类词汇，帖子是被分类的内容实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tags; provenance: direct source tags

name: votes
definition: 用户对帖子表达赞成或反对态度的信息记录，包含投票类型、时间与悬赏金额。 Counterexample: 与评论不同：投票是二元或分类的态度表达，评论是文字反馈。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table votes; provenance: direct source votes

name: User
definition: A registered account on the platform, identified by DisplayName or Id.

name: UserReputation
definition: The reputation score accumulated by a user.

name: UserAge
definition: The age attribute of a user profile.

name: Post
definition: A piece of content (question or answer) posted on the site.

name: PostScore
definition: The net score of a post.

name: PostViewCount
definition: Number of times a post has been viewed.

name: PostFavoriteCount
definition: Number of times a post was marked as favorite.

name: PostCreationDate
definition: Timestamp when a post was created.

name: PostClosedDate
definition: Timestamp when a post was closed; NULL means still open.

name: PostTitle
definition: The title text of a post.

name: PostTag
definition: Tags associated with a post, stored as a delimited string.

name: Badge
definition: An achievement awarded to a user.

name: BadgeDate
definition: Timestamp when a badge was awarded.

name: Comment
definition: A comment left by a user on a post.

name: CommentCreationDate
definition: Timestamp when a comment was created.

name: Vote
definition: A vote cast by a user on a post.

name: VoteCreationDate
definition: Timestamp when a vote was cast.

name: BountyAmount
definition: Bounty amount attached to a vote.

name: PostHistoryEdit
definition: A revision/edit event recorded in post history.

name: ElderUserPostCount
definition: Number of posts owned by users older than 65. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id) WHERE UserAge > 65. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; UserAge = users.Age WHERE Age > 65

name: HighScorePostCount
definition: Number of posts with score >= 20. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id) WHERE PostScore >= 20. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostScore = posts.Score

name: UsersWithManyBadges
definition: Number of users awarded more than 5 badges. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT User.Id) WHERE COUNT(Badge.Name) > 5. Inputs: User = users.Id; Badge = badges.Name

name: AvgPostScorePerUser
definition: Average score of posts owned by a given user. Formula: AVG(PostScore) GROUP BY User. Inputs: PostScore = posts.Score; User = users.Id

name: PctPostsByHighRepUsers2011
definition: Percentage of 2011 posts whose owners had reputation > 1000. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011 AND UserReputation>1000) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011) * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostCreationDate = posts.CreaionDate; UserReputation = users.Reputation
aliases: percentage of posts by high reputation users in 2011
pct posts by high rep users 2011

name: PctRPostsByCommunity
definition: Percentage of Community-owned posts tagged with R. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostTag='r' AND User.DisplayName='Community') / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE User.DisplayName='Community') * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostTag = posts.Tags WHERE Tags LIKE '%<r>%'; User = users.Id
aliases: percentage of R posts by Community

name: PctHighScorePostsByElderUsers
definition: Among posts with score > 5, percentage owned by users older than 65. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5 AND UserAge>65) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5) * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostScore = posts.Score; UserAge = users.Age WHERE Age > 65
aliases: percentage of high score posts by elder users
pct high score posts by elder users

name: PctHighScorePostsByTopUser
definition: Percentage of posts by the highest-reputation user that have score > 50. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>50 AND UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostScore = posts.Score; UserReputation = users.Reputation
aliases: percentage of posts with score above 50 by most influential
pct high score posts by top user

name: FirstVoteDate
definition: Earliest vote timestamp for a user. Formula: MIN(VoteCreationDate) GROUP BY User. Inputs: VoteCreationDate = votes.CreationDate; User = users.Id

name: FirstBadgeDate
definition: Earliest badge award date for a given badge name. Formula: MIN(BadgeDate) WHERE Badge.Name = 'Autobiographer'. Inputs: Badge = badges.Name; BadgeDate = badges.Date

name: PostPopularity
definition: Popularity of a post measured by view count. Formula: SUM(PostViewCount) GROUP BY Post. Inputs: PostViewCount = posts.ViewCount; Post = posts.Id

name: HigherReputationUser
definition: Comparison of reputation between two users. Formula: MAX(UserReputation) GROUP BY User. Inputs: UserReputation = users.Reputation; User = users.Id

name: PostHistoryTypes
definition: Types of events recorded in post history (edits, closures, etc.).

name: VoteTypes
definition: Categories of votes cast on posts (upvote, downvote, bounty, etc.).

name: PostTypes
definition: Types of posts (question, answer, wiki, tag wiki, etc.).

name: LinkTypes
definition: Types of links between posts (duplicate, related, etc.).
